issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): The problem statement's UML declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as a public method (problem_statement.md line 70), but the solution implementation declares it with protected visibility (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 75). The template leaves a TODO for this method (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 12) so students will implement the method themselves; the mismatch between the UML (public) and the provided solution (protected) can confuse students about the intended API and lead to tests or examples that expect a public method failing or students implementing a different visibility than the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent across artifacts. Either change the solution method signature to public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() (recommended to match the UML and expected public API), or update the UML/problem statement to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents() as protected if protected was intended. Also update the template comment/signature guidance (if present) and any tests/examples to match the chosen visibility so students have a single, consistent expectation.
